question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of arcsine is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[8\operatorname{arcsin}⁡({e}^{x})] \\  & =8\cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{({e}^{x})}^{2}}}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({e}^{x}) \\  & =\frac{8}{\sqrt{1-{e}^{2x}}}\cdot {e}^{x} \\  & =\frac{8{e}^{x}}{\sqrt{1-{e}^{2x}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
